feedback.answered: The offline recovery boundary is now described from source: RecoverCluster refuses to run without existing state, restores the newest snapshot it can open and fails if none can be restored, applies only LogCommand entries from the log tail while advancing lastIndex/lastTerm over every scanned entry, writes a new snapshot whose configuration is the operator-supplied one at configuration index 1, and deletes the entire stored log range so stored configuration entries cannot interfere. Its consequences are recorded as the forced installation of a configuration outside the membership protocol, the emptied log, and the discarded FSM.
